title: The Screaming Cosmonaut Story Is Completely Fake

scenes.voiceover: You've probably heard that a dying cosmonaut screamed and cursed as his ship fell to Earth. That story is completely fake.
In 1967, cosmonaut Vladimir Komarov became the first human to die during an actual spaceflight, when his parachutes failed on reentry.
scenes.mainText: THE FIRST HUMAN TO DIE ON A SPACEFLIGHT

scenes.voiceover: One book claimed a listening post overseas caught him screaming and cursing in rage during his final minutes. That story comes from a single, unconfirmed source.
Historians have since used the real archived transcripts to prove it false. What he actually said was calm, and professional, right to the very end.
scenes.mainText: I FEEL EXCELLENT. EVERYTHING'S IN ORDER.

scenes.voiceover: He still died in that crash. But he died calm, doing his job, not screaming in terror. The myth erased the truth.
He's one of eighteen people who've died flying to space. What actually happened to all of them is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: 18 PEOPLE. THE FULL STORY → ON THE CHANNEL
